name: CASH
oneLiner: CASH is Phantom and Bridge Building's centralized USD stablecoin on Solana, redeemable 1:1 and backed by short-term U.S. Treasuries, repos, and MMFs.
collateral: U.S. Treasury bills (≤3 months maturity), reverse repurchase agreements backed by U.S. Treasuries, U.S. government money-market funds, deposit accounts, and tokenized equivalents held in segregated bankruptcy-remote accounts
pegMechanism: Direct 1:1 redemption via Bridge Building Inc. (BBI) with reserves held in bankruptcy-remote custodial accounts

applicabilityBasis.summary: CASH is a Bridge-issued U.S. dollar payment stablecoin for Phantom with 1:1 redemption through Bridge.

genius.notes: Bridge issuer and Phantom materials describe CASH issuance and redemption, but Pharos found no token-specific public GENIUS approval as of review.

sourcesChecked: OCC GENIUS Act rulemaking bulletin and public releases
Bridge Open Issuance documentation and legal terms
negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No token-specific public GENIUS PPSI approval, state-qualified approval, or official application source was located for CASH.

blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: Resolved from Pharos stablecoin metadata by the blacklistability resolver; no separate manual override source is attached.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Inferred review retained: CASH resolves to Yes because existing metadata classifies the asset as centralized and no manual override narrows that status.

mintAuthority.summary: CASH is a Phantom/Bridge Open Issuance Solana stablecoin. The Token-2022 mint exposes separate mint, freeze, permanent-delegate, confidential-transfer, and close authority keys; signer custody remains unresolved.

controls.label: CASH Token-2022 mint authority
controls.evidence: Finalized Solana RPC at slot 421905275 returned this address as mintAuthority for mint CASHx9KJUStyftLFWGvEVf59SGeG9sh5FfcnZMVPCASH. RPC getAccountInfo for the authority returned null, so custody/PDA identity is unresolved.

controls.label: CASH permanent delegate / close / confidential-transfer authority
controls.evidence: Finalized Solana RPC returned this address as mintCloseAuthority.closeAuthority, permanentDelegate.delegate, and confidentialTransferMint.authority.

controls.label: CASH freeze authority
controls.evidence: Finalized Solana RPC returned this address as freezeAuthority.

review.evidence: Bridge-hosted token metadata identifies the CASH mint, and Phantom/Bridge materials identify CASH as a Solana stablecoin launched through Bridge Open Issuance. Solana RPC resolves the current Token-2022 authority fields.
unresolvedQuestions: Map mint authority HJT2TXrhbWta2ax7V86vcnmX7ZmAVzua4v2yrGwchXB7 to a Bridge/Phantom signer, PDA, multisig, or MPC policy.
Confirm whether transferHook.programId being null is expected and whether any future hook authority can install transfer restrictions.
